title: Stock-versus-asset transaction tax structure
prompt:
Evaluate the buyer economics of a stock purchase versus an asset acquisition or Section 338 election.

Begin with the FY26 tax-provision and EBITDA-definition thread in `Requests/`, including the close-review follow-up. Use the current controller-tied workpapers and operating extracts, keeping earlier versions only for comparison. Resolve conflicts using dates, approvals, document status, and management correspondence. Reconcile posted Alder Ridge balances through the contractor-accounting MCP; keep external targets, peer data, bank terms, and market evidence tied to their controlling finance sources.

Value depreciable and goodwill-amortization tax shields over their respective lives at the approved discount rate. Compare total step-up benefit with seller gross-up and incremental transaction costs, calculate the maximum economic gross-up, and make a recommendation only after testing legal feasibility, positive economics, and the buyer consideration limit.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Also rebuild tax shields by asset class with bonus and mid-year conventions and show all three independent recommendation gates. Apply 0.50 of the post-bonus straight-line deduction in Year 1, full deductions in intermediate years, and 1.50 in the final recovery year; discount each shield at year minus 0.50. The legacy goodwill-labeled outputs include the Goodwill class only; Customer relationships are separately modeled and included in the total class-level benefit. Incremental asset-structure cost includes the seller gross-up plus asset-deal costs less stock-deal costs. Seller gross-up shortfall to the economic ceiling equals the economic ceiling less the seller's required gross-up, so a positive result is headroom.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `annual_depreciation_tax_shield`, `annual_goodwill_amortization_tax_shield`, `pv_depreciation_tax_shield`, `pv_goodwill_tax_shield`, `total_step_up_tax_benefit`, `incremental_asset_structure_cost`, `net_asset_structure_benefit`, `maximum_economic_seller_gross_up`, `recommended_structure`, `class_level_year_1_tax_shield`, `class_level_pv_tax_shield`, `class_level_net_asset_structure_benefit`, `seller_gross_up_shortfall_to_economic_ceiling`, `legal_feasibility_gate`, `incremental_consideration_gate`, `positive_npv_gate`. Use dollars to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals, and lists as JSON arrays.
